title: Candidate linked biological task scopes and optional extensions
source_scope: Public primary research only; no participant records downloaded

policy_scope.AB1_population: Named ambulatory adult 18-65 catchment with explicit task eligibility; age limits are policy
policy_scope.AB1_temporal_block: 14 days, policy starting point requiring precision validation
policy_scope.AB2_longitudinal_blocks: baseline, 3 months, 12 months, policy horizons not proof of lifetime dynamics
policy_scope.AB2_ordering: AB1 attainment retained; common targets must meet h_AB2=h_AB1/2 plus all declared extension targets. This policy tightening divides variance limits by four.
policy_scope.suite_rule: Conjunction of required task/domain/role targets; unknown remains unknown; no global scalar or device bonus
policy_scope.narrow_study_rule: A study may lead or pass a named task without passing the suite; no blanket small-N penalty
policy_scope.observation_vs_intervention: controlled stimuli, ex-vivo perturbations and in-vivo randomized interventions remain different role/evidence classes
policy_scope.optional_extension_rule: AB2-NP is separately named and does not gate core AB2. Its explicit claim still requires every declared target and role.

claim_lanes.conditional_design: Registered planned geometry and explicit assumptions; no treatment success or held-out model utility
claim_lanes.realized_record: Same target mechanics plus verified retained support/QC/linkage
claim_lanes.empirical_learning_plateau: Optional separate claim requiring held-out performance and equivalence; never a gate on planned capacity

precision_authority.target_scale_rule: Native units; no per-competitor SD normalization. Use independently frozen biological resolution delta_star, policy h=delta_star/2, or retain unresolved.
precision_authority.prior_rule: Freeze an external prior; always expose prior-only attainment and acquired variance reduction. Population-learning claims additionally report likelihood-only precision or identifiability; do not fabricate information from a strong prior.
precision_authority.functionals_vs_joint: Only registered functionals are covered. All-direction claims require a separately frozen covariance target and existing Loewner diagnostic.

tasks.title: Metabolic response shape
tasks.biological_question: Can the record resolve a persons glucose and C-peptide response to a standardized meal, and variation in those responses across people?

estimands.definition: Signed baseline-subtracted glucose AUC over 0-120 minutes, with baseline modeled jointly
Signed baseline-subtracted C-peptide AUC over 0-120 minutes

scope.time: 0-120 minutes after a registered meal; two repeat occasions within the candidate 14-day block
scope.space: venous circulating concentrations; interstitial glucose substitutes only with calibrated lag/bias operator
scope.population: declared adults 18-65 catchment; population inference uses independent people, not meal repeats

tasks.reconstruction_relevance: Trajectory response adds a state-transition measurement beyond fasting concentrations; it does not identify insulin sensitivity or secretion rates without additional validated model information.

target.choice_rule: h_j = delta_star_j/2 is a candidate resolution policy; delta_star_j must be independently justified and frozen. If no justified resolution exists, target remains unresolved.
target.multiplicity: Freeze familywise interval coverage and task/functionals before evaluation; proposed 95% familywise is policy, not biological evidence.

missing_calibration: Assay total-error covariance and limits of quantification
Within-person day variance versus between-person variance
Interpolation error at the actual schedule
Meal adherence, circadian phase, medication and prior-exercise effects
concrete_calibration_protocol: Use external repeated-meal calibration with split aliquots and dense reference sampling
Fit assay + day + donor variance components without using candidate-study outcome benefits
Validate downsampled AUC against dense integration and estimate interpolation bias
Freeze the matrix of integration weights and joint covariance, including baseline subtraction, then solve required repeats and N

AB2_extension.new_estimands: Within-person difference in the two AUCs between two preregistered meal compositions under randomized crossover, with period/carryover adjustment
AB2_extension.new_scope: Both meal conditions at repeated blocks at baseline, 3 months and 12 months (policy windows); no universal annual completeness claim
AB2_extension.missing: Exact contrast protocol, washout validity, carryover covariance and between-person response heterogeneity; no universal arm count beyond the named contrast

tasks.main_objection: Two metabolites under one meal are not a full metabolic model. AUC can hide timing; include prespecified early/late contrasts in a later task revision if calibration shows material aliasing.
tasks.mechanics_status: Can compile linear summaries once actual schedule/operator/covariance/prior and target authority exist; do not fabricate geometry from titles or assay counts.

tasks.title: Peripheral immune responsiveness
tasks.biological_question: Can an accessible blood sample resolve specified molecular immune responses while separating donor biology from handling and cell mixture?

estimands.definition: Paired stimulated-minus-control TNF concentration at the frozen endpoint of a validated whole-blood assay
Paired stimulated-minus-control IL-6 concentration at the same endpoint
Absolute monocyte and lymphocyte abundance in the input specimen as separate adjustment observables

scope.time: One registered ex-vivo endpoint t_immune, to be selected from validated assay protocol; repeat draw at matched clock phase within 14-day block
scope.space: whole blood only; not brain, liver, gut or lung immune states
scope.population: same named adult catchment; donors are independent units

tasks.reconstruction_relevance: Perturbed immune output distinguishes resting abundance from responsiveness; matched cell composition helps detect a mixture explanation for molecular change.

target.choice_rule: h_j = delta_star_j/2 is a candidate resolution policy; delta_star_j must be independently justified and frozen. If no justified resolution exists, target remains unresolved.
target.multiplicity: Freeze familywise interval coverage and task/functionals before evaluation; proposed 95% familywise is policy, not biological evidence.

missing_calibration: Stimulus/control paired covariance and batch interaction
concrete_calibration_protocol: Run reference-lab split-sample and repeat-draw calibration across donor and handling blocks
Use validated safe assay authority; this candidate specifies no stimulus dose or procedure
Fit composition-adjusted response model while retaining unadjusted response
Freeze endpoint, two cytokines and limits before examining competitor designs

AB2_extension.retained_targets: Retain AB1-I and tighten h by factor 2
AB2_extension.new_estimands: Within prespecified monocyte and T-cell compartments, a frozen small transcript-response set under one validated matched specimen challenge; separate cell abundance from within-cell response
AB2_extension.new_scope: Cell-type resolution in blood; repeat at baseline, 3 and 12 months
AB2_extension.missing: Cell-assignment confusion, capture bias, transcript count/noise model, donor covariance and protein/transcript relation; no assumption that single-cell RNA measures protein function

tasks.main_objection: Selected cytokines and cell classes privilege peripheral immunity; the assay cannot certify immune competence or whole-body tissue coverage.
tasks.mechanics_status: Can compile linear summaries once actual schedule/operator/covariance/prior and target authority exist; do not fabricate geometry from titles or assay counts.

tasks.title: Functional exertion and recovery
tasks.biological_question: Can the record resolve physiological response to a fixed registered workload and the early recovery trajectory?

estimands.definition: Peak-to-one-minute heart-rate decrease under a frozen exercise and recovery posture/procedure
Integrated oxygen uptake above pre-exercise baseline over first 5 recovery minutes

scope.time: During registered exertion and 0-5 minutes recovery; repeat occasion after validated recovery
scope.space: cardiorespiratory functional outputs, not every organ or autonomic mechanism
scope.population: eligible subset of the named catchment; exclusions and support limit must be explicit

tasks.reconstruction_relevance: A fixed input and recovery response constrain physiological transitions and functional reserve that static molecular counts alone do not measure.

target.choice_rule: h_j = delta_star_j/2 is a candidate resolution policy; delta_star_j must be independently justified and frozen. If no justified resolution exists, target remains unresolved.
target.multiplicity: Freeze familywise interval coverage and task/functionals before evaluation; proposed 95% familywise is policy, not biological evidence.

missing_calibration: Heart-rate/sensor latency and breath-by-breath VO2 covariance
Peak selection and temporal interpolation uncertainty
concrete_calibration_protocol: Calibrate sensor outputs against criterion instruments and repeated challenge records
Freeze workload parameterization and recovery conditions; assess peak-selection bias
Use known time-integration weights where valid and propagate correlated error
Do not import a mortality-risk threshold as an estimation tolerance

AB2_extension.retained_targets: Retain AB1-F and tighten h by factor 2
AB2_extension.new_estimands: Response slope across two registered workload conditions and between-block change in that slope
AB2_extension.new_scope: At baseline, 3 and 12 months; fixed functional eligibility population
AB2_extension.missing: Dose-response linearity/locality, order/fatigue covariance, selection and temporal stationarity

tasks.main_objection: The one-minute HR measure is protocol-sensitive and the source clinical population does not establish normative values for all adults.
tasks.mechanics_status: Can compile linear summaries once actual schedule/operator/covariance/prior and target authority exist; do not fabricate geometry from titles or assay counts.

tasks.title: Daily physiological rhythm and behavior linkage
tasks.biological_question: Can linked digital observations separate a persons daily physiological rhythm from movement and sleep timing?

estimands.definition: Cosine coefficient in a preregistered 24-hour HR rhythm model adjusted for activity and measured context
Sine coefficient in the same model
Person-level mean sleep midpoint under a registered sleep-detection definition
estimands.unit: hours relative to local reference time

scope.time: Candidate 14-day observation block; timestamps, time zone and valid-wear support preserved; duration is policy not universal sufficiency
scope.space: peripheral cardiovascular rhythm and behavioral sleep, not a direct central circadian clock measurement
scope.population: named catchment; shift-work status and missingness declared

tasks.reconstruction_relevance: Links temporal context to physiological state and prevents a daytime snapshot from being treated as a universal baseline. Sine/cosine coefficients avoid unstable phase estimates when amplitude approaches zero.

target.choice_rule: h_j = delta_star_j/2 is a candidate resolution policy; delta_star_j must be independently justified and frozen. If no justified resolution exists, target remains unresolved.
target.multiplicity: Freeze familywise interval coverage and task/functionals before evaluation; proposed 95% familywise is policy, not biological evidence.

missing_calibration: Wearable/device bias versus ECG and sleep reference
concrete_calibration_protocol: Obtain independent simultaneous device/reference recordings across rest/activity/skin-tone/context coverage
Estimate autocorrelation and missingness model from repeated complete days
Use DLMO or a justified central-clock reference only if a later task claims central circadian phase
Freeze design columns and reference time; derive cadence/day support from coefficient precision and conditioning

AB2_extension.retained_targets: Retain AB1-D and tighten h by factor 2
AB2_extension.new_estimands: Change in sine/cosine coefficients under a registered within-person schedule/context contrast plus stability across repeated blocks
AB2_extension.new_scope: Baseline, 3 and 12-month blocks; prespecified schedule groups
AB2_extension.missing: Phase-response nonlinearity, schedule assignment/overlap, light exposure, confounding and drift

tasks.main_objection: Behavior-adjusted rhythm remains model-dependent; wearable sleep midpoint cannot be relabeled melatonin phase or neural sleep architecture.
tasks.mechanics_status: Can compile linear summaries once actual schedule/operator/covariance/prior and target authority exist; do not fabricate geometry from titles or assay counts.

tasks.title: Time-resolved neural response
tasks.biological_question: Can the record resolve a prespecified event-related neural contrast together with task behavior?

estimands.definition: Mean deviant-minus-standard ERP voltage over a fixed task-specific time window and registered sensor cluster, selected before study scoring
Mean correct-trial reaction time under the fixed paradigm, with error rate retained as a separate observable

scope.time: Stimulus-locked millisecond timing; window and trial counts selected by independent reference-paradigm calibration; two sessions in candidate 14-day block
scope.space: registered scalp observation field only; no unvalidated cortical-source localization
scope.population: named adult catchment with sensory/task eligibility declared

tasks.reconstruction_relevance: Provides an actual neural temporal response linked to behavior, rather than assuming peripheral biomarkers or questionnaires observe neural function.

target.choice_rule: h_j = delta_star_j/2 is a candidate resolution policy; delta_star_j must be independently justified and frozen. If no justified resolution exists, target remains unresolved.
target.multiplicity: Freeze familywise interval coverage and task/functionals before evaluation; proposed 95% familywise is policy, not biological evidence.

missing_calibration: Trial noise/autocorrelation and retained artifact-free trial support
Amplitude dependence on task performance and sensory input
concrete_calibration_protocol: Use a frozen ERP CORE-style paradigm and reference preprocessing, then calibrate repeat sessions independently
Prefer a preregistered window-average linear contrast over winner-picked peak amplitude
Estimate trial/session/person variance and artifact-related selection
Derive trial counts and people separately; no universal EEG channel count or MRI requirement

AB2_extension.retained_targets: Retain AB1-N and tighten h by factor 2
AB2_extension.new_estimands: Add a preregistered left/right cortical-region hemodynamic task contrast with linked electrophysiological measurements, plus between-block change
AB2_extension.new_scope: Two named cortical ROIs and frozen hemodynamic model; baseline, 3 and 12-month blocks
AB2_extension.missing: Spatial sensitivity/registration, HRF uncertainty, physiological confounds, cross-modal residual covariance and motion bias; fMRI earns no credit outside this spatial task

tasks.main_objection: ERP is an accessible neural probe, not comprehensive cognition; the spatial extension may make this candidate unnecessarily expensive and should be separately ratified.
tasks.mechanics_status: Can compile linear summaries once actual schedule/operator/covariance/prior and target authority exist; do not fabricate geometry from titles or assay counts.

tasks.title: Linked population variation
tasks.biological_question: Can the study estimate population means and specified cross-domain associations without confusing repeated measurements with independent people?

estimands.definition: Population means of each prespecified AB1-M/I/F/D/N scalar target under declared sampling/selection weights
Three prespecified descriptive correlations: meal glucose AUC with HR recovery; immune TNF response with daily HR cosine coefficient; neural ERP mean with task reaction time
estimands.unit: Fisher-z scale for precision calculation; report native correlations too

scope.time: Cross-domain records within same 14-day state block; exact timing/ordering accounted for
scope.space: person-linked outputs from five tasks; unrelated participants cannot supply cross-domain covariance
scope.population: fixed adult catchment, eligibility and sampling weights; not all humanity

tasks.reconstruction_relevance: Population reconstruction requires between-person structure; this task prevents unlimited data on two people from masquerading as population breadth. Correlations are descriptive, not causal biology.

target.choice_rule: h_j = delta_star_j/2 is a candidate resolution policy; delta_star_j must be independently justified and frozen. If no justified resolution exists, target remains unresolved.
target.multiplicity: Freeze familywise interval coverage and task/functionals before evaluation; proposed 95% familywise is policy, not biological evidence.

missing_calibration: Cross-domain covariance and common nuisance structure
Inclusion/sampling weights and missing joint modules
concrete_calibration_protocol: Use independent donors with all required linked modules, stratified to the declared population
Fit multilevel measurement-error model with repeat occasions separating within-person noise from between-person variability
Freeze only these descriptive edges before scoring; validate delta-method/Fisher-z coverage by simulation under actual sampling
If Gaussian linearization fails, retain this task unresolved rather than supply invented F

AB2_extension.retained_targets: Retain AB1-P and tighten h by factor 2
AB2_extension.new_estimands: Fixed site-A versus site-B difference in the same means/associations, plus change across baseline, 3 and 12-month blocks
AB2_extension.new_scope: Two named settings with overlap; optional age extension to 18-80 must be separately specified and is not automatically covered
AB2_extension.missing: Selection overlap, site measurement invariance, attrition, site-by-person response covariance; two sites do not establish universal random-site transport

tasks.main_objection: The selected correlations are arbitrary but falsifiable cross-domain probes; evidence has not established these particular edges as privileged biological coordinates. Their inclusion is a policy choice.
tasks.mechanics_status: Can compile linear summaries once actual schedule/operator/covariance/prior and target authority exist; do not fabricate geometry from titles or assay counts.

extra_AB2_task.title: Identifiable cortical perturbation response
extra_AB2_task.biological_question: Can the experiment distinguish a registered direct cortical perturbation response from sensory coactivation and sham?

estimands.definition: Within-person active-minus-sensory-matched-sham mean evoked electrophysiological response in a preregistered post-artifact window and sensor/source region, conditional on verified assignment and target engagement
estimands.unit: microvolt or frozen source-current unit, never mixed

scope.time: Stimulation-locked response plus repeat-session reliability; exact artifact-free window selected only after independent calibration
scope.space: one registered cortical target and bounded response region
scope.population: eligible consenting research population with explicit exclusions

missing_calibration: Exact target/site and intervention protocol authority
Stimulation/EEG artifact operator and residual covariance
Verified target engagement and assignment adherence
Within-person period/session dependence and between-person heterogeneity
concrete_calibration_protocol: Require a validated independently reviewed research protocol; no stimulation parameters are prescribed here
Perform independent sham/sensory and device-artifact calibration before defining the response window
Freeze contrast operator and correlated repeated-trial variance, then derive participant/session requirements
extra_AB2_task.main_objection: High burden and sensory confounding; a separate optional extension, never inferred from diagnostic EEG/fMRI or a sensory task. Membership and protocol need independent review.

calibration_program.deliverable: Ratified task definitions and native-unit meaningful-resolution dossier; blinded task relevance/measurement review before comparing studies
Independent crossed donor x occasion x batch x device reference data, with paired technical replicates and dense time/reference measurements as appropriate
Estimated operator H, residual R, between-person B, nuisance blocks and uncertainty envelope; effective independent units explicit
Precision-target derivation using H^T R^-1 H, random effects and frozen c_j; choose cadence/repeats/N jointly, not a universal N
Operating-characteristic simulations at lower/upper plausible calibration bounds, including censoring/missingness/nonlinearity and nuisance sensitivity
Source-bound authority and machine input only after h_j,H,R,P definitions are available; biology utility evaluation remains separate

sources.title: Berry et al. 2020, Human postprandial responses to food and potential for precision nutrition
sources.supports: Human meal-response heterogeneity supports measuring dynamic metabolic responses; does not validate our task thresholds.
sources.access_scope: Primary publisher abstract and PMC-indexed methods excerpt reviewed.

sources.title: Duffy et al. 2014, Functional analysis via standardized whole-blood stimulation systems
sources.supports: Standardized induced immune-response measurements can characterize donor variation; our stimulus/time/target subset is a policy proposal.

sources.title: Cole et al. 1999, Heart-rate recovery immediately after exercise
sources.supports: One-minute post-exercise heart-rate drop is an established measurable recovery quantity; prognostic cutoffs are not adopted as precision targets.
sources.access_scope: Primary publisher abstract and methods summary reviewed.

sources.title: Bowman et al. 2021, A method for characterizing daily physiology from widely used wearables
sources.supports: Wearable HR and activity support model-based daily-rhythm estimation; behavior and physiological phase are distinct.
sources.access_scope: Primary research abstract and indexed full-text excerpt reviewed.

sources.title: Kappenman et al. 2021, ERP CORE
sources.supports: Standardized ERP paradigms and prespecified processing support bounded neural response measurements; source sample size is not benchmark saturation.
sources.access_scope: Author repository abstract and primary author PDF excerpt reviewed.

sources.title: Squair et al. 2021, Confronting false discoveries in single-cell differential expression

sources.access_scope: Primary full-text sections reviewed in earlier council audit.

sources.supports: Cell-type-resolved donor responses and tissue limits are empirically demonstrated; blood does not become lung or brain.
sources.access_scope: Primary publisher abstract and tissue-limitation passage reviewed; no viral experiment proposed.

sources.supports: Linked EEG/fMRI observations are feasible; no complete neural reconstruction claim follows.

sources.supports: Human stimulation with electrophysiological observation motivates a distinct cortical perturbation task.

sources.supports: Auditory/somatosensory coactivation can confound direct cortical interpretations; sham and artifact calibration are essential.

sources.supports: Small population associations require appropriate independent-person support; this is not a universal N minimum for within-person tasks.

objections: This panel covers accessible state/response tasks, not complete whole-body biological reconstruction.
Blood-centric immune and metabolic tasks omit many tissues and pathological states.
Four modality domains do not imply coverage of all causal mechanisms or six ANI axes.
Spatial neural resolution adds burden and remains a proposed scope. Cortical perturbation is an optional named extension, not a universal requirement.
Correlation target choices and h/2 strictness are policy, not discoveries from cited papers.
Several nonlinear population/correlation and cell-type models cannot yet be submitted as exact linear-Gaussian tasks without a justified local approximation.
Two named contexts support a fixed-context comparison, not general transport.
